name: Ghost Face
summary: Cute flat white sheet ghost with a wavy hem and an O mouth, floating, for boo, spooky or Halloween moments.

params.name: s
params.note: scale; about 380 px wide at s = 1

params.name: color
params.note: sheet colour; a slightly darker shade is added for depth

params.name: anim
params.note: idle motion from p.f; float bobs up and down and blinks

params.name: popIn
params.note: springs in over the first 10 frames
